text: Maintaining a healthy lifestyle involves more than just eating well. A balanced diet, rich in fruits, vegetables, and whole grains, gives your body the fuel it needs. Regular exercise, even a brisk 30-minute walk most days, strengthens your heart and boosts your mood. Equally important is getting enough quality sleep—aim for seven to nine hours—as this allows your body and mind to recover. Pay attention to your mental health too; taking small breaks to relax or practice mindfulness can reduce stress. Finally, strive for a good work-life balance by setting boundaries and making time for hobbies and loved ones. These habits work together to create a healthier, happier you.
